items.title: UK retirement confidence rises slightly but remains low among adults
items.summary: Research from Nucleus indicates that UK retirement confidence has edged up over the past year, though only one in five adults feel highly confident.

items.title: Saba Capital Management calls special meeting for US fund merger
items.summary: Saba Capital Management has summoned shareholders to vote once more on merging its US-based Capital Income & Opportunities funds.

items.title: BNY enters European ETF market with five active fixed income strategies
items.summary: BNY has launched its first exchange-traded funds in Europe, offering five actively managed fixed income products.

items.title: Vanguard launches first active fixed income ETFs in Europe
items.summary: Vanguard has introduced its debut active fixed income exchange-traded funds in European markets, targeting corporate issuance.

items.title: Pensions minister sets summer 2027 launch for MoneyHelper Dashboard
items.summary: The pensions industry has welcomed plans for the public launch of the MoneyHelper Pension Dashboard next summer following an update from pensions minister Torsten Bell.

items.title: Paratus and Foresight report positive outcome from UK solar price insurance policy
items.summary: Energy price risk insurer Paratus and investment manager Foresight Group have completed an insurance arrangement covering six operational UK solar projects.
